description: Removes an idea that does not fit, with a reason; upTake will not suggest it again.

project.description: Which project: its id or site (example.com) from uptake_projects. Optional when the maker has a single project.

reason.description: Why it does not fit: not_relevant (not relevant), already_done (already done), wrong_numbers (wrong numbers), not_my_channel (not a channel i use), too_much_time (too much time), other (other).

name: uptake_dismiss_idea
title: Dismiss an idea
